spec.data_source: Current IAM service account identity and read-only paginated google.iam.serviceAccount.Insight records.
spec.predicate: A complete current insight inventory has no ACTIVE unused-usage insight matching the current service account identity. A fresh ACTIVE unused-service-account insight names the current immutable service account identity with at least 90 days of observation and no contradictory bound recent authentication.
spec.title: Service account has no active unused-access insight
spec.description: Reviews explicit ACTIVE SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE insights from Google IAM Recommender. The current service account email and immutable numeric unique ID must both match, with at least 90 days of observation and a fresh insight. This captures provider-classified unused accounts even when no authentication timestamp exists; recent bound authentication contradicts an unused classification.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm service account ownership and dependencies before disabling obsolete identities or removing their grants.

description.description: Reviews explicit ACTIVE SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE insights from Google IAM Recommender. The current service account email and immutable numeric unique ID must both match, with at least 90 days of observation and a fresh insight. This captures provider-classified unused accounts even when no authentication timestamp exists; recent bound authentication contradicts an unused classification.
evaluated: current service account email, numeric unique ID and disabled state
ACTIVE SECURITY SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USAGE identity and target project
observationPeriod of at least 90 days and lastRefreshTime within three days
description.pass_when: A complete current insight inventory has no ACTIVE unused-usage insight matching the current service account identity.
description.fail_when: A fresh ACTIVE unused-service-account insight names the current immutable service account identity with at least 90 days of observation and no contradictory bound recent authentication.
description.not_applicable_when: The service account is disabled; missing, denied or inconsistent insight evidence remains unresolved.

requirements.reason: Bounded identity lifecycle evidence: a current ACTIVE Google unused-service-account insight identifies a service account with at least 90 days of observed inactivity. This supports the identity review requirement; organizational necessity, human users and timely deactivation are outside this predicate.
